reviews.decision_slice: Choice selected values are index-based; /V and /I persistence; Table 234 /I interpretation
reviews.evidence: Current Table 234 corrected by EC3 Issue #468; current code `pdf-model/src/form.rs::selected`; new candidate duplicate-label test; existing `text_choice_fields_spec_audit.rs` and `saving.rs` controls.
reviews.verdict: Preserve the index-valued host API and V-over-I rule for actual disagreement. Revisit the narrow assertion that /I only resolves duplicate display labels: with V array [(Twin)(Twin)] and matching I [0 1], the two entries agree about two options, but current mapping collapses one. The historical ADR may be sound for the shape it addressed; it is not evidence for current behavior under #468.

reviews.decision_slice: EC3 #468 read as removed MultiSelect restriction and deleted array trigger; claim that code already matched
reviews.evidence: `doc/errata-read.md:116` plus effective overlay status as recorded there; printed Table 234 is still pre-correction text. New repeated-label array scenario exercises the amended table rather than the old trigger.
reviews.verdict: Keep the accepted correction and its established consequence that /I can be present outside the old restricted case. Qualify the conclusion that current code was already right: candidate shows an array of duplicate labels can be reduced to one index. Confirm full overlay scope before promoting this as a normative defect; no test execution occurred here.
